text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold stocks at gains, but my account value still ended below its starting level; realized wins alone do not show whether my overall strategy is working.","Selling winners while leaving other positions untouched can skew my portfolio, so I should review each holding and my overall allocation rather than focus only on locking in gains.","I should not avoid selling a position just because a loss feels painful; decisions should reflect my goals and the current portfolio, not my purchase price or the comfort of realizing a gain."]}
